Abolition of National Anti-Crime Task Fotce. - The National Anti"Crime
Task Force (NACTAF), created pursuant to Executive Order No. 463 (EO) dated 23 September
2005 is hereby abolished.
Section 2. Funds, AsrlB and Equipmenf-,- All the funds, assets and equipment of
the NACTAF shall be turned over to the National Anti-Environment Crime Task Force (NAECIAF)
created pursuant to EO 515 (s. 2006).
Section 3. Repealing Ctause. - All orders,' rules, regulations and other issuances or
parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.
